title: Casper and the Current
premise: Desert ranger Noor Okafor chases a thief across the salt flats and instead finds a dying prospector who trades her a map to the Meridian's wreck for a promise: see it claimed by the man's estranged daughter, not the salvage fleet that killed him. Pursued by the fleet's enforcer and the law that abandoned her years ago, Noor must reach the wreck six tides before the dry season seals it forever. In the drowned hold she finds the daughter, Juna, alive and hiding, and together they outwit the fleet, claim the inheritance on their own terms, and choose each other over the justice the courts never gave.
about_author: Astrid Nystrom is a former field cartographer who spent a decade mapping dry lakebeds and ghost towns before turning to fiction. She writes adventure stories about people who keep moving because standing still was never safe.

chapters.title: The Man Who Paid in Promises
chapters.summary: Noor Okafor tracks a thief across the salt flats, only to find him gutted beside a dying prospector. With his last breaths, the prospector gives her a tide-charted map to the Meridian and makes her swear it goes to his daughter, Juna — never to Vane's salvage fleet. POV: Noor. Emotional beat: reluctant obligation replacing the numbness of endless pursuit.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: Noor reaches the coastal settlement of Brackwater and learns the fleet is already hunting the map — and that Juna Okafor-Brandt has been missing for two years, presumed dead. Vane's enforcer corners her; she escapes with a stolen skiff and a new ally, the ferryman Doss. POV: Noor. Emotional beat: rising dread as the clock of tides becomes real and personal.

chapters.title: What the Water Kept
chapters.summary: Inside the half-drowned wreck, Noor finds Juna alive, living off the hold and nursing her own grudge against both father and fleet. As the dry season drains the sea, Vane's crew breaches the hull, forcing the two women into a desperate fight through flooding corridors where Noor nearly drowns saving Juna. POV: alternating Noor and Juna. Emotional beat: trust forged under water, grief finally spoken aloud.

chapters.title: Claimed by Tide and Name
chapters.summary: Using the prospector's charts, Noor and Juna spring their trap: they let Vane's flagship ground itself on the exposed reef as the last tide recedes, then salvage the Meridian's manifest themselves and present it to the harbor magistrate as lawful claim. The fleet scatters; the thief's debt is paid with testimony. POV: Noor. Emotional beat: quiet resolution — an inheritance shared, a found family anchored at last.
